Bangladesh is one of the most accident-prone countries in the world. The reasons behind the accidents are the inefficiency of drivers, reckless attitude, the tendency not to abide by the traffic rules, flaws in the design of roads or highways, lack of awareness of pedestrians, etc. The corruption of a class of officers and employees in the police force and transport department is also indirectly responsible for this.
